column3: Close to the Hebrew; “and I [am] prayer” is rendered “But I give myself to prayer.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְשָׂטָן (“an accuser, satan”) is rendered “an accuser.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “their bread.”
Close to the Hebrew; “may the creditor ensnare” is rendered “Let the creditor seize,” and “his property” “his labor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “one who extends covenant loyalty” is rendered “none to extend mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the narrative past (“it came to him… it was far”) as wishes, “so let it come… so let it be far.”
Close to the Hebrew; the narrative past “it came into his inward parts” is rendered as a wish, “So let it enter his body.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O Yahweh, O Lord” is printed “O GOD the Lord,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; נֶהֱלָכְתִּי (“I have gone”) is rendered “I am gone.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lean from fatness” is rendered “feeble from lack of fatness.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the statements as wishes (“Let them curse… let them be ashamed”).
